dek: Eight Shenandoah waterfalls with trail lengths, difficulty ratings, fees and flow. Dark Hollow Falls is the short, steep favorite; Lower Whiteoak is the easiest walk.
overview: Shenandoah National Park describes itself as 75 miles from Washington, DC, with cascading waterfalls across more than 200,000 acres of Virginia.

We cover eight waterfalls here, and seven have a published walk length and elevation gain, which makes Shenandoah one of the easiest parks to plan a waterfall hike in. Dark Hollow Falls draws the most visitors. Miller Falls is listed by USGS at 25 feet tall but has no walking distance.
fallsIntro: Whiteoak Canyon has two waterfalls on the same trail. Lower Whiteoak Falls is the shorter walk and Upper Whiteoak Falls the longer one, so they are listed separately.
plan: For a short outing, Dark Hollow Falls is 1.4 miles round trip with about 440 feet of climbing. The park rates it moderate and points out that the steep, rocky climb back up is the hard part, not the walk down. Lower Whiteoak Falls is the easiest in the park at 2 miles round trip and about 500 feet.

For a longer day, Upper Whiteoak Falls is 4.6 miles round trip on the same Whiteoak Canyon Trail, so you don't need to add the lower falls separately. Rose River Falls is a 4-mile loop and South River Falls a 3.3-mile loop, each with about 910 feet of climbing. Doyles River Falls is 3.3 miles round trip with about 1,189 feet. Overall Run Falls is the longest at 5.1 miles round trip and 1,291 feet, and the park notes it can have minimal or no flow unless there has been plentiful rain, so skip it in a dry week.
flow: The nearest gauge with a complete record is the South Fork Shenandoah River near Lynnwood (01628500), about 7 miles from Doyles River Falls. From 2019 through 2024 its average daily flow peaked in February at about 1,694 cubic feet per second and was lowest in July at about 420.
Shenandoah's waterfalls are small side streams, so treat the river as a general rain signal. After a dry stretch some of them, Overall Run in particular, can run very low.
feesLead: Entrance is $30 per vehicle, and the park is cashless at these entrances.
access: According to the park's Lower Whiteoak notes, you can buy a pass at the Whiteoak Canyon lower trailhead. Annual and interagency passes are accepted. The waterfalls are spread along the ridge near the towns of Stanley, Washington, Stanardsville and Grottoes, so expect to drive between trailheads.
safety: The park rates Dark Hollow Falls moderate and warns that the climb back up is the hard part. Doyles River, Rose River, South River and Upper Whiteoak are also rated moderate, with climbs between 910 and 1,189 feet. Lower Whiteoak is the only one rated easiest, so match the hike to your legs.
